verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex documents a REST API with OAuth 2.0 that includes Worker and State Taxes resources, plus use cases for keeping Paychex in sync with an external HR system. That plausibly covers creating the employee and setting up taxes programmatically. However, the evidence never shows an explicit worker-create call, compensation setup, or a complete end-to-end onboarding flow, and the probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: explicit worker-creation endpoint docs, compensation/pay-rate API setup, documented end-to-end onboarding sequence, OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent onboard a new hire end-to-end via the API — creating the employee, compensation, and tax setup
